title: Pomegranate's beams (빨대)
body: Her skill gives +69% skill amp for 9 s through beams. The beam count rises with the Volley (다발) synergy stacks she holds when she casts: her first cast fires 3, and the guide counts +2 from Herb and +3 from Tiger Lily. Volley is granted by ally skills, per the game's skill texts: Cheesecake's orbiting letters, Tiger Lily's mount (to nearby allies, so Pomegranate can miss it when they stand apart) and Herb's heal. Cheesecake's per-cast stack count isn't in any source yet. Beams go to the highest-ATK allies (ATK, not power) and never to herself. Her level and ATK don't change the buff.

title: Milk and the welfare perks
body: Milk's ATK buff scales with her ATK. 열정페이 (+20% ATK, −20% max HP) and 초고속승진 (+7% ATK) go to the highest-ATK ally, so Milk has to be ATK #1. Milk usually dies at the 17 s wipe because of 열정페이's HP cut.

title: Cheesecake's buff overrides Milk's
body: A cookie holding Cheesecake's ATK buff loses Milk's: measured 483K ATK with Milk alone vs 228K with both. The best case is Cheesecake buffing Milk (667K), which is why formation matters.

title: Crit above 100%
body: Crit rate past 100% rolls extra crit tiers: 200% always crits twice, and 198% is one crit plus a 98% chance of a second. Each tier adds (50% + bonus crit dmg). Above 100% effective crit rate, +10% crit dmg beats +10% crit rate. The raid boss has no crit resistance.

title: Skill haste formula
body: Cooldown = base × 100 / (100 + haste). 50 haste cuts a cooldown by 33%, not 50%. Only the parent skill's cooldown is hasted; internal delays and durations aren't. No cap was found in the data.

title: Brightseeker haste breakpoint
body: A model of a 43 s fight finds haste pays off steeply until about 40 total, then stalls. In a 30 s fight (team dies at the slam), trading haste for skill amp is better: going from 20 to 40 haste loses about 3.4%. Past about 58 haste her drones start splitting onto adds.

title: Lift resistance
body: A skill is cancelled if its cookie is airborne for 0.4 s or more. Resistance stacks as base + extra − base×extra: 20% base, 48% with Pinot, 64% with Pinot plus a 20% pet. Candy Shade Pouch goes up to 30% (plus 12.5% HP).

title: Skill amp nerf (8/27)
body: Skill amp no longer boosts stat-reduction debuffs (Dark Choco included) or damage-reduction buffs, and enemy DEF can't go below 0. That's why Dark Choco runs haste.

title: Boss
body: 지나치게 무거워진 피냐타 (Extra Stuffed Piñata) is Dark with a Light weakness (Brightseeker is Light). Big slam at 30 s elapsed; super-jump wipe at 17 s remaining. Crit resistance on your side does nothing here, and accuracy and focus aren't needed.

title: Octo Wasabi pet
body: +40% duration-synergy effect and +10% ATK for duration-synergy allies. The pet card says 10%; posters and one video guide measure +8% when Scorpion enters (disputed). The bonus isn't shown on the stat screen, so ATK-order tuning has to add it by hand, and it can reshuffle the order mid-fight.

title: Tea Knight is raid-only
body: Every 10 s: a 155.2% ATK thunder strike and all allies Boss DMG +70% for 10 s, in Guild Conquest only (+45% at the lowest grade). That's why she's in every top deck. She stands at the front and often misses Milk's buff, which is the most common cause of stray beams.

title: Surviving the 17 s wipe
body: Posters put the floor at about 9M HP and 45% damage reduction per surviving cookie. A 9.4M HP / 45.6% DR Brightseeker lived to about 9 s left using HP and DR pets. The ATK-order carries (about 5M HP) and Milk (열정페이 HP cut) still die; at 21G account power, Macaron, Brightseeker, Pomegranate and Skating Queen survived and kept dealing damage until 8 s left. This is the leading explanation for the Season 5 jump, but only as a timing match.

title: No manual control since 9/10
body: Manual control in Guild Conquest was removed on 9/10, so placement comes from deck composition only. That's why a Lv.1 Cherry Cookie is carried: it pushes Brightseeker in front of Macaron.

title: Skill amp scales Milk's buff (8/13)
body: Since the 8/13 patch skill amp applies to Milk's ATK-increase effect, which is why Milk is ATK #1 and the leader in every top deck.

title: Weapon: crit rate or crit dmg
body: At equal skill amp, check crit rate after Macaron's buff: under 30 (the last two digits) take crit dmg, at 30 or more take crit rate to push the next crit tier. Skill amp wins over both when it's higher.

title: HP to survive the slam
body: Cookies need about 3.5–4M HP to live through the 30 s slam. Level barely matters for that, because gear and lab HP research give a Lv.1 cookie about 4M HP in raid.

title: Sugar rune slots and rolls
body: Rune slots unlock with stars (★6, two at ★8, two at ★10). Per-line maxima: ATK% 7, crit rate 8, crit dmg 8, skill amp 5 (SSR), skill haste +5 (SSR; SR tops out at +3).

title: Gear enhancement
body: Sub-options jump at +5, +10, +15 and +20 (+130% at +15, +200% at +20). Max skill-haste roll is +4.6 at +15. Only accessory groups roll haste.
